name: Ricochet
effect: When you throw or toss any item you can bounce it off any stable surface before it hits: it ricochets off one surface, then moves 15 ft in a straight line of your choice. Ricocheting toward a target you can't see: normal blind penalties (−4 Acc and Eva). Only solid objects (thrown weapons; bullets/arrows/bolts only with Ricocheting Bullets) can be ricocheted; potion vials yes (break at the final target unless designated otherwise), liquids alone, spewed fire, sound, force, aether rays, spit, bio-zappers no.

name: Boosting Redirection
effect: When an ally within range of your ricochet makes a ranged attack or toss, use one of your own projectiles to redirect it (may change its target); it gains 5 ft of range per Marksmanship point.

modifiers.label: ft range added to ally projectile

name: Long Bounce
effect: A ricocheted object travels 30 ft instead of 15 ft.

name: Ricocheting Bullets
effect: All Ricochet-related specialties work with any projectile (firearms, bows…). Multiple projectiles in one action (e.g. Spread Launch) can each be ricocheted in different directions with all ricochet specialties applied.

name: Skipping Stones
effect: Ricochet an item several times in one throw (each in a straight line, directions may differ). Marksmanship roll: 2 ricochets / 3 ricochets / 4 ricochets / 5 ricochets

name: Consistent Skips
effect: No roll needed: ricochet one additional time per 4 Marksmanship points (8 points = 3 ricochets). You may still roll Skipping Stones instead.

name: Trajectory Master
effect: Ricochet no longer costs the extra AP.

name: Deflecting Shot
effect: When any ranged attack travels within range of your weapon or thrown item (including ricochet distance), reflexively hit the projectile with one of your own: roll Acc; if you meet or beat the attack's Acc, it is knocked harmlessly away.

name: Return to Sender
effect: After a successful Deflecting Shot, send the projectile back: the attacker rolls Evade against your Deflecting Shot roll; on a failure they take Tier 1 damage of their own attack including all its modifiers, specialties and augments (also those that raise the damage tier). Modifiers that depend on accuracy (e.g. Critical Hits) are ignored.

name: Countershot
requires_text: 21 Marksmanship; Ricochet; Trajectory Master; Deflecting Shot
effect: Return to Sender no longer costs the extra AP; it happens automatically with every successful Deflecting Shot.

name: Ricochet Attack
effect: You can ricochet off people: each person bounced off takes 2 soakable damage that cannot be evaded (no augments/modifiers/specialties apply to it; not dealt to the final target).

name: Harder Impact
effect: Ricochet attacks deal 4 damage instead of 2.

name: Better Impact
effect: Ricochet attacks ignore 1 soak class per 5 Marksmanship points.

modifiers.label: soak class ignored by ricochet attacks

name: Targeted Ricochet Attacks
effect: For +1 AP make one ricochet attack a called shot (more AP for more). Roll Stk once; it applies to everyone you hit, including the final target if attacking. Location Seeking and other called-shot augments apply.

name: Duck & Cover
effect: When an ally is in a blast, give them a bonus to dodge it equal to your Tactical skill. With Change Places you can use both for a single AP; if Change Places moves them out of the area they need not spend AP to dodge.

name: Muscular Pushback
requires_text: 3 Resilience; 11 Marksmanship; Ricochet, Deflecting Shot, Return to Sender
effect: When hit by a ranged attack with a solid projectile you take the damage normally but ricochet it back: your Acc vs their Evade; on failure they take Tier 1 damage of their own attack with all its modifiers (accuracy-dependent modifiers ignored).

name: Right into their Hands
effect: Allies catch items you toss to them for 0 AP. Launching an item to an ally with a ranged weapon counts as a toss.

name: Ad-Hoc Grenades
effect: Fashion a weak grenade from materials you carry and throw it at any space within 50 ft (can't be used as a weapon). Damages that space and all adjacent: 5 damage / 10 damage / 15 damage / 20 damage. Dodge as a normal explosion (1 AP reflexive Dex, tiers down).

name: Cooking
cost: As an attack, reflexive (after activating an explosive)
effect: Hold an activated explosive and throw it reflexively right before it detonates (normally at the start of your next turn); if you fail to throw it, it explodes in your hand. You may have it explode mid-flight anywhere along its path.

name: Lightning Defuser
effect: Disarming an explosive costs 1 AP. If an explosive lands or is activated within your reach, you may reflexively try to disarm it (1 AP).

name: No Accidents
effect: Your disarm attempts never cause detonation. Anti-handling fuses can still detonate it, but you get one tier higher when rolling to disarm them.

name: Pre-Planted Mines
cost: Activating the fuse +3 AP reflexive; resist Cunning (negates)
effect: When an opponent moves into a space within 10 ft of you, declare you had planted a mine there (from your stock). They resist with Cunning against your Gadgetry (concealment bonuses of the mine, e.g. Concealable/Miniscule, add to your roll); on a failure they step on it. On success they may enter without triggering. The mine stays and can be picked up after the battle if not detonated.

name: Blast Impervious
requires_text: Pyrotechnician; Blast Dodger or Soaring Dodge
effect: You are immune to explosives you crafted and activated yourself: no dodge needed, no damage, no ill effects.

name: Bomb-Building Basics
effect: Learn the augments Anti-Handling Fuse, Concealable, Damaging, Extended Blast, Powerful Blast and Quick-Set. For any you already know, learn a different one instead.

name: Friendly with Explosives
effect: Allies in the area of an explosive you activated automatically soak 5 damage per marque you can craft (mQ II = 10).

modifiers.formula: 5 * (1 + min(1, gadgetry // 5) + min(1, gadgetry // 15) + min(1, gadgetry // 25))
modifiers.label: damage allies soak from your explosives

name: Scanning Activator
requires_text: Pyrotechnician; Reflexive Detonation; Remote Activation augment known
effect: Pick one explosive carried by your target and roll Gadgetry: if your tier ≥ the highest marque on it, it activates (detonates at the start of your next turn), even without Remote Activation. Subtlety: unless they know you can do this, the target notices only if their Cunning beats your Gadgetry roll.

name: High-Heat Explosives
effect: Explosives you created and activated burn victims who don't escape the blast; roll when activating: Tier 1 Burns (-1 on defense rolls) / Tier 2 Burns (-3 on defense rolls) / Tier 3 Burns (-5 on defense rolls) / Tier 4 Burns (-7 on defense rolls). Burns recover at the victim's next breather.

name: Reflexive Detonation
effect: Use a placed remote-activation explosive reflexively whenever an opponent moves. You may also detonate any activated explosive reflexively once the turn you activated it is over (no need to wait for your next turn).

name: Firebomber
effect: You can create firebombs (explosives that spew fire over several seconds). Build and maintain firebombs for free per your DIY score; learn 2 firebomb augments; marques rise with Gadgetry. Each firebomb has 3 augment slots (wooden 2, organic 1); some augments take several slots.

name: Beta Firebombs
effect: Firebombs get 2 more augment slots (metal = 5). Others using one need a Sciences tier one higher than its highest augment marque (mQ IV → T5).

name: Prototype Firebombs
effect: Anyone can use a firebomb you designate as a prototype.

name: Controlled Blast
effect: Shape a firebomb's area as a straight line (15 ft from the centre) or a cross (10 ft in 4 directions); set when crafting, or change on the spot for 1 AP.

name: Bombs Away
effect: Activating the firebomb you are throwing costs 0 AP.

name: Close Enough
effect: People on the outer edge of your firebombs still take damage as if it were one marque lower. You need not tell escaping victims that your firebombs are extra hot.

name: Rolling Explosive

requires.note: Rolling Explosive is meant for firebombs; without Firebomber you can only roll explosives you got elsewhere.

effect: After throwing a firebomb choose a direction; each time your AP refresh it moves 5 ft that way. (No listed requirement; useful only with Firebomber.)

name: Squib Producer
effect: You can build squibs. Build and maintain squibs for free per your DIY score; learn 2 squib augments; marques rise with Alchemy. Each squib has 3 augment slots; some augments take several slots.

name: Beta Squibs
effect: Squibs get 2 more augment slots (metal = 5). Others need a Sciences tier one higher than the highest marque (mQ IV → T5).

name: Prototype Squibs
effect: Anyone can use a squib you designate as a prototype.

name: Micro-Bombadier
effect: Craft fully augmented squibs on the fly: 1 squib crafted / 2 squibs crafted / 3 squibs crafted / 4 squibs crafted. Never more handcrafted squibs on you than your DIY allows.

name: Micro-Mastery
effect: Micro-Bombadier costs 2 AP (still capped by DIY).

name: Quick-Flick
effect: Draw and activate squibs for 0 AP.

name: Squib Mass Production
effect: Micro-Bombadier produces twice as many: 2 squibs crafted / 4 squibs crafted / 6 squibs crafted / 8 squibs crafted (still capped by DIY).

name: Cluster Bombs
effect: Throw (or fire through a delivery device) several squibs at one targeted space: 2 squibs launched / 3 squibs launched / 4 squibs launched / 5 squibs launched. A device with a readying cost must be readied as normal.

name: Spread Launch
effect: For +1 AP with Cluster Bombs, divide the squibs among as many targets as you like.

name: Raining Down Bombs
effect: Spread Launch no longer costs the extra AP with Cluster Bombs.
